From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap — token profile & next steps

Hi Laura — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

Summary of what you shared:
- Primary workload: customer support summarization + answer-generation (mix of short responses and long form context expansion).
- Typical turn length: 20–150 tokens, median ~45.
- Expected concurrency: 30–60 sessions initially, spike to ~150/day.
- Initial pilot target: 3 months, want to validate cost model at ~5M tokens/day peak.
- Procurement target: budget band of $40k–$90k/month for pilot phase (flexible depending on committed bands).

Ask from us: please confirm the expected average tokens/day (low/typical/peak) — I sketched three scenarios in the attached burn model. Based on your range, Marissa will pull together a one-page estimate (unit economics + committed pricing bands) and an invoice-ready estimate you can share with procurement.

Key proposal highlights (ballpark until you confirm volumes):
- On-demand: estimated $27–$30 / 1M tokens for median workload (higher for long-form generations).
- Committed/Reserved bands (monthly):
  - 100M/mo: $22 / 1M tokens
  - 500M/mo: $17.5 / 1M tokens
  - 1B+/mo: custom rate (we can target $12–15 / 1M tokens with a 12mo commit)
- Recommend a 3-month pilot with a 20% committed discount band to validate run-rate and then move to a 12-month reserved commit if numbers hold.

Attachments: velosys_burn_model.xlsx — I modeled low/typical/peak using your 45-token median, and included cost curves for both on-demand and reserved options.

Proposed next steps:
1) Laura: confirm average tokens/day for Low / Typical / Peak scenarios (reply inline).
2) Redwood: Marissa to send a one-page invoice estimate + attached detailed burn model; Ben to schedule follow-up demo if useful.
3) Velosys: share procurement contact for PO path once numbers look reasonable.

Happy to hop on a 30-min follow-up tomorrow afternoon if easier — available 2–4pm PT.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Laura — looping in with a short, invoice-style estimate attached plus the updated burn model. I adjusted the committed bands to reflect the volumes Laura provided.

Headline estimate (3-month pilot, typical profile = 8.5M/day):
- Estimated monthly tokens (typical): 8.5M * 30 = 255M tokens/month
- Monthly cost, on-demand: 255 * $0.027 (per 1k tokens basis converted) = approx $6,885 — note: we model per-1M-token pricing below for clarity.

Committed pricing bands (applied to monthly committed volume):
- 250M/mo band: $18.50 / 1M tokens -> monthly = $4,717.50
- 500M/mo band: $16.00 / 1M tokens -> monthly = $4,080 (if you commit to top-of-band and reach it)

For pilot sizing (3 months):
- Conservative path: 3mo trial at 250M committed band to hold unit economics near $18.50 / 1M — this yields a predictable invoice (~$4.7k/mo) and protects you from on-demand spikes.
- Burst path: keep a small on-demand buffer for peak days (we recommend a 20% burst pool to avoid throttles).

Attached: redwood_invoice_estimate.pdf (one-page estimate you can share with procurement), updated velosys_burn_model.xlsx (tab: "banded-commit"), pilot_scope.docx (scope + success criteria).

Notes on unit conversions: our billing is per 1M tokens. In the attached spreadsheet I included both per-1M and per-1k conversions so your finance team can slot numbers into internal models. Also included a short sensitivity table showing the effective $/1M if average tokens/day move +/- 20%.

Next steps from Redwood side:
1) If Velosys confirms they want the 250M/mo pilot band, we will produce a formal quote and a DocuSign estimate for signature.
2) Sergio can review SLA/uptime SLAs if you need them in the quote (we typically include a 99.9% baseline for Dedicated pilots).
3) Ben will pick a time for a short walkthrough of the attached spreadsheet with your procurement/finance.
